recipe:
(stated; checks in code and in the JSON `parity` block; note knowledge/synthesis/rq2_source_curve-assumptions.md) A1 "M1 + M2 (no M3)" = Task 14's pre-M3 recipe (rq3_build_preds.py), rebuilt on the subset S: harness M1 = 0.5 x S4 + 0.5 x fused(S), 0.3 DepMap-neighbour blend from the library(S) where a covered neighbour exists, energy-matched to (0.5 S4 + 0.5 fused(S)) (ml_h1fuse.build); fused(S) = ml_h1fuse.fixed_fusion over the 8 min_cells members with the frozen family weights zeroed outside S (member data = h1fuse/

_data.npz, the exact arrays the ERA pack was built from); library(S) = both recipe parts (part 0: c 100 uncentred, equal weights, x3; part 1: c 50 centred, W_NEW, x1.6; 0.5/0.5) fused over S only -- linear in the per-family means, so it is assembled exactly from per-family arrays (A4); then F2's sum side: ew (1+cpm/50)^-0.25 -> centring 0.5 -> guarded top-3 library-PC removal with V3 = PCs of library(S) -> M2 = rank(cross-family agreement over S)^0.5 -> budget match. A2 S4 (the learned refit + FiLM residual model, 50 % of M1) is HELD FIXED at its frozen leave-destination-out fit for every subset (KOLF: the A3 kolf-free S4 of Task 14). Refitting it 841 times is out of budget and its training table mixes sources outside the family registry. So the primary curve prices a family through the fusion part, the neighbour library, the library PCs and M2, CONDITIONAL on S4. Sensitivity arm `noS4`: M1 without S4 (total = fused(S) with the same neighbour blend, energy-matched to fused(S)), i.e. a pure source-count curve. A3 M2 is undefined when < 2 families of S measure a target (verbatim agreement -> NaN -> median rank). If no target has an agreement (always at k = 1), M2 is off (constant amplitude) -- the only change to the verbatim code. A4 Library per family (exact): fam_mean_f(t, g) = mean over the family's sources of log((fp 1e6 + c)/(fc 1e6 + c)) - centre (sources with >= 20 cells for t); part L = clip(sum_f w_f fam_mean_f / sum_f w_f has_f, +-3). Stored float32. A5 Budget. PRIMARY arm `own`: the recipe's own budget, Bt(S) = B(max(1, kink(S))) from the subset's own M1 (kink factor 1.17, margin 0.8; C_real(n) jackknife is control-only and computed once per panel, rng 0) -- what the builder would do with fewer sources. Because Bt(S) != Bt(K) in general, offline numbers of this arm are NOT guaranteed exact (AGENTS.md: the offline evaluator is exact iff budget-invariant) -> the `bt_rel` column flags it and the H1 real scorer spot check (k = 1, ceil(K/2), K) decides whether the curve is reported in absolute or relative terms (threshold |PDS_real - PDS_offline| > 0.002). Arm `fixBt`: same direction, budget matched to the full-set Bt(K) (budget-invariant relative to the K build -> offline-exact for the comparison with k = K). A6 Offline scorer = the ERA pack evaluator (`score_

.npz` real moments), with the subset's own override Od (the promoter-floor override depends on the fused delta). KOLF: Task 14's kolf-free FENG stores + S4 (Amendment A3). A7 Fits (descriptive; subsets overlap, so points are not independent and AIC is a descriptive comparison only): log-linear PDS = a + b ln k (OLS) vs saturating PDS = a - c exp(-k / tau) (least squares, tau in [0.05, 200]); Gaussian AIC = n ln(RSS / n) + 2 p (p = 3 / 4 incl. the variance), on subset-level points (primary) and on the K k-means (sensitivity). Delta AIC < 2 -> "indistinguishable". A8 LOFO marginal value = mean over families f and targets t of pds_t(K) - pds_t(K \ f) (positive = the family helps); 95 % percentile CI from B = 2,000 bootstrap draws resampling families (the K LOFO subsets) and targets independently (rng 0). Composite on H1: sum-side composite change from the vcc2026 preset scaling constants (tv2_score.CONST: PDS (x - 0.5)/0.4515, MSE clip((x - 0.984)/(0.043 - 0.984), 0, 1), each / 6); the DE side is not rebuilt (NMAE/reach/fid/jaccard fixed), so this is the PDS + MSE share only.

arms.own: PRIMARY: frozen M1 (S4 fixed) + M2, own budget (recipe-faithful)
arms.fixBt: same direction, budget matched to the full-set Bt(K) (offline-exact relative to k = K)
arms.noS4: sensitivity: M1 without S4 (pure source-count curve), own budget
